in_marathi.name: Riyansh
in_marathi.long_meaning: Riyansh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Lord Rama, a divine name which was born to King Dasharatha and Queen Kausalya. He is considered as the seventh avatar of Lord Vishnu. He is an embodiment of truth, morality, and courage.
